description:
Build the new swarm-manager shell around a left sidebar, center graph canvas, and right inspector instead of the current top-tab-first layout.

This work should:
- introduce the new shell layout and route structure
- make the graph canvas the main workspace rather than a secondary page
- move entity browsing, filtering, sorting, and saved views into the sidebar
- move selected-node details and actions into an inspector surface
- relocate settings/info/reference entry points into header controls instead of treating them as primary navigation tabs
- define mobile behavior cleanly instead of preserving desktop tab assumptions
- hard-cut to the new shell rather than maintaining parallel old and new navigation systems

This item is about the application frame and interaction model, not about finalizing all graph lenses.
name: swarm-manager-graph-workspace-shell
title: Replace the Tabbed Shell with the Graph Workspace Shell
